audit.whatIsWrong: Rated TRICKY 7/10 while the win rate is 49.93% over 3026 games and the level chart hands Akshan six of seven rows.
audit.why: Difficulty must agree with the data. Akshan out-ranges Dark Sphere (850 vs 800) and her only lockdown, Scatter the Weak, is 650 range on a flat 15s.
audit.corrected: EVEN, 5.5/10. Syndra carry threat stays 7.5/10 — she still wins the first-item row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 written as Syndra's row in phases[] while win[] and the packet give it to Akshan; her real spike row is first item.
audit.why: Comeuppance is 2500 range against her 675 ultimate, so 6 favours Akshan. Her spike is the first AP item plus Splinters of Wrath, when Force of Will's true damage ignores the MR you bought.
audit.corrected: phases sides realigned to Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Syndra/Akshan; spikes[2] rewritten around Splinters and true damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unleashed Power described as 'a long-range point-and-click stun-into-burst combo'. It is neither long-range nor a stun.
audit.why: Unleashed Power is 675 range and deals damage only; the stun comes from Scatter the Weak (650, flat 15s) and only when it knocks a Dark Sphere through you. Transcendent adds an execute to the ultimate and true damage to Force of Will, so armour and MR are the wrong answer. Akshan's Heroic Swing is knocked off on champion or terrain collision, and her E's knockback ends a swing.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], mid, wants.foe[1] and breakdown.cooldowns now name the correct ability, range and 15s cooldown.

audit.why: Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s at all ranks and is the whole green light; Dark Sphere is a flat 7s, so poke never stops.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization advice would be read as 'stack MR'; spikes[2] credits Akshan with Sheen procs.
audit.why: Akshan builds no Sheen item, and Transcendent grants Force of Will bonus true damage, so raw MR does not solve her.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why is garbled placeholder text and calls Akshan's ultimate 'Vengeance'.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around the 2500 vs 675 range gap.

edits.after: Both ults land at 6: Comeuppance reaches 2500, hers only 675 — chip first, then channel.

edits.before: Syndra wins by landing Scatter the Weak (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Syndra wins by knocking a sphere through you with Scatter the Weak, then chaining true damage into an Unleashed Power execute.

edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. It governs your forward steps. - E Heroic Swing spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s at every rank and only stuns through a Dark Sphere — stay off the line between her and her orbs, and step up the second it whiffs. - Dark Sphere is a flat 7s, so poke never stops; spend Heroic Swing on her E, never on her spheres.

edits.before: Carry through strings and executes — chip everything, finish anything under a third, and let the swing write angles no one wards.
edits.after: Carry by respecting 650 units: outside Scatter the Weak her only answer is a 7s sphere you sidestep. Chip, then Comeuppance from 2500.

edits.before: If Syndra takes first blood, tighten up: Scatter the Weak (Stun) is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q strings and stay relevant through R executes.
edits.after: If Syndra takes first blood, count Splinters instead of health bars — Transcendent makes her ultimate an execute. A second kill and the duel is over: farm outside 800 and stay relevant through Comeuppance.

edits.before: Ahead, bully harder: string Syndra off every contact, swing-roam the rivers, and execute the map's mistakes with R.
edits.after: Ahead, starve her Splinters: string her off every CS, roam on her 7s sphere, and Comeuppance anyone she chips low.

edits.before: Unleashed Power is a long-range point-and-click stun-into-burst combo that can delete you from well outside your own engage range if you're caught without W camouflage up.
edits.after: Unleashed Power is only 675 range and needs Scatter the Weak's sphere stun to land first, but Transcendent's execute deletes you the moment you are caught without camouflage.

edits.before: Even with a full stun-combo answer, her damage still requires landing the initial stun; a first item on your side (Sheen procs, more mobility) lets you dodge and punish the whiff.
edits.after: Her burst still needs the E stun first, but her first item plus stacked Splinters push Force of Will's true damage through whatever MR you bought, so this window belongs to her outright.

edits.before: Her point-and-click stun combo is a genuine one-shot threat the instant it's live.
edits.after: Comeuppance out-ranges her 675-unit ultimate, so the level 6 row still belongs to you.

edits.before: Level 6 is genuinely dangerous — Unleashed Power is a long-range stun into full burst that can one-shot you if you're caught without camouflage up, so you have to respect her cooldown and never walk up blind during this window.
edits.after: Level 6 is genuinely dangerous — Scatter the Weak's sphere stun into a 675-range Unleashed Power can one-shot you if you're caught without camouflage up, so you have to respect her 15s E and never walk up blind during this window.
